capabilities: Generate an adjacency matrix of vault links
Pan and zoom the matrix image
Show tooltips linking note A to note B
Mark which folder each note belongs to
Save the matrix image to the vault
disambiguation: Not the core Graph view; it renders links as a square grid image rather than a node-edge diagram.
problem: Obsidian only shows the vault graph as a node-edge diagram; there is no grid/matrix representation of links.
summary: Generates an interactive adjacency-matrix image of the vault graph, with pan, zoom, tooltips, folder colours, and image saving.
